Chúng đến từ người đang sống, làm việc và đi lại trên vùng đất này. Panorama ghi lại những chia sẻ có nguồn và có thể kiểm chứng. Anh Tuấn Ghi nhận tuyến đường Hà Bắc đang được nâng cấp, thảm nhựa. Chị Mai Chia sẻ những mức giá được biết đến quanh hồ Bãi Công. /en/long-term-rental-nam-ban.title: Long-Term Rental Near Da Lat: Renting a House or Villa in Nam Ban | Namban Panorama
/en/long-term-rental-nam-ban.h1: Long-term rental near Da Lat: renting a house or villa in Nam Ban
/en/long-term-rental-nam-ban.desc: Renting a house or garden villa in Nam Ban, about 25 km from Da Lat, for a month or longer: villas about 8–15 million VND a month, ordinary houses 4–8 million (Sept 2026), what to check, foreigner registration and visas.
h2: What kind of place can you rent in Nam Ban?
How far is Nam Ban from Da Lat for everyday life?
What should you check before renting a house in Nam Ban?
Does the owner need to register a foreign tenant?
Can you stay one to three months on a visa?
What should a rental agreement in Nam Ban include?
How much does it cost to rent a house in Nam Ban?
Is Nam Ban a good place for a long stay near Da Lat?
Frequently asked questions
faq: Can I rent a house in Nam Ban long term?

Yes. Garden houses, village houses and some villas or homestays take guests for a month or longer. Nam Ban has far fewer listings than Da Lat, so asking around in person during a short first visit often works better than searching online.
How far is Nam Ban from Da Lat?
About 25 km, roughly 45 minutes by car over the Tà Nung pass. Liên Khương airport is about 20 km away, 35 to 45 minutes.
Does a foreigner renting a house in Vietnam need to register?

Yes. The person running the place where a foreigner stays — including a private house — must declare the foreigner's temporary residence to the local police within 12 hours of arrival (24 hours in remote areas), under Article 33 of the Law on Entry, Exit, Transit and Residence of Foreigners.
How much does it cost to rent a house in Nam Ban per month?

In September 2026 we observed newly built villas at about 8–15 million VND a month (roughly US$310–580) and ordinary houses at about 4–8 million VND (US$155–310). Hotels run about 250,000–800,000 VND a night, and professionally run homestays about 800,000–1.2 million. Compare offers on the full monthly cost, including electricity, water and internet.
What should I check before renting in Nam Ban?

Where the water comes from (most homes use a borehole well), how the road behaves in the rainy season, the internet line at that exact house, damp inside the house, hot water, and whether the owner will register your stay.
Can a foreigner buy a house in Nam Ban instead of renting?

Generally not. A foreigner cannot hold land-use rights to ordinary land, and may own housing only inside approved commercial housing projects, which is not the kind of property around Nam Ban. We set this out in our guide on foreign ownership.
/en/long-term-rental-nam-ban.region_text: Short answer Yes, you can rent a house or a garden villa in Nam Ban for a month or longer. It is a quieter base about 25 km from Da Lat (around 45 minutes over the Tà Nung pass), with Liên Khương airport about 20 km away. In September 2026, newly built villas here rented for about 8–15 million VND a month (roughly US$310–580) and ordinary houses for about 4–8 million (US$155–310). Expect far fewer listings than in Da Lat, so you find places by asking as much as by searching. Before you sign, check four things on the ground: water (most homes run on a borehole well), the road in the rain , internet at that exact house , and whether the owner will register your stay . By law, the place where a foreigner stays must declare them to the local police within 12 hours. Most people searching for a long-term rental "in Da Lat" picture the city itself. Nam Ban is not a district of Da Lat. It is a separate commune in Lâm Đồng province, in the Central Highlands, lower and warmer than the city and close enough to use it for errands. That trade — space and quiet for a drive — is the whole point of renting here, and also its main cost. We describe the place itself in Living in Nam Ban . This page is about renting. What kind of place can you rent in Nam Ban? Garden houses. A house on a plot of land, often with a coffee or fruit garden around it. The type that fits a slow, longer stay. Village houses along the main road. Closer to the market, shops and the provincial road ĐT.725; more traffic noise, less garden. Villas and homestays taking monthly guests. Often newer and with a view, and often priced by the night for visitors rather than by the month for residents. Listings on international rental sites are thin for Nam Ban compared with Da Lat. Some places are let by word of mouth rather than listed, so a first visit of a few days, asking around in person, can find what a week online does not. How far is Nam Ban from Da Lat for everyday life? About 25 km, roughly 45 minutes by car over the Tà Nung pass. Liên Khương airport is about 20 km away, 35 to 45 minutes. On a map this looks like a suburb. In daily life it is not: you go to Da Lat for a hospital, a big supermarket or a night out, and you plan the trip. What Nam Ban has in town: a central market open all day and busiest in the morning, a bank and a pharmacy chain around it, schools from kindergarten to high school, a commune health station and a general clinic. For hospital care you drive to Da Lat, or to Đinh Văn, where the Lâm Hà Regional Medical Centre (Trung tâm Y tế khu vực Lâm Hà) is. Most people here get around by motorbike or car. Without your own transport, errands take planning. What should you check before renting a house in Nam Ban? Water. Piped water from Da Lat has started to reach houses along ĐT.725, but most homes still draw from a borehole well. Ask where the water comes from, how deep the well is, and whether there is a filter. The road in the rain. Many lanes are red earth. Visit after rain, or ask how the last stretch to the house behaves in the wet season. Internet at that house. Fibre is available in Nam Ban, but check the line and the speed at the exact house before you plan remote work around it. Damp. The rainy season runs roughly from April–May to November. A house left closed through it gets damp inside. Look at walls, wardrobes and bedding. Hot water and nights. Nights are cool for much of the year. Ask about hot water and blankets rather than air conditioning. Morning noise. This is farmland. Small farm vehicles start early, and harvest months are busy. The neighbours. Ask who lives on either side. In a village, they matter more than the view. Does the owner need to register a foreign tenant? Yes. Under Vietnam's Law on Entry, Exit, Transit and Residence of Foreigners (Article 33), the person who runs the place where a foreigner stays — a hotel, a homestay or a private house — must declare that foreigner's temporary residence to the local police, within 12 hours of arrival (24 hours in remote areas). It can be done online. In practice: ask the owner before you move in whether they will register you, and keep your passport ready. An owner who hesitates about this is telling you something about the rest of the arrangement. Can you stay one to three months on a visa? Often, yes. Citizens of twelve countries — Germany, France, Italy, Spain, the United Kingdom, Russia, Japan, South Korea, Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland — can enter visa-free for up to 45 days, under a policy in force from 15 March 2025 to 14 March 2028. Citizens of twelve more European countries — Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, the Czech Republic, Hungary, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Poland, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia and Switzerland — get the same 45 days for tourism, from 15 August 2025 to 14 August 2028. Vietnam's e-visa allows stays of up to 90 days, single or multiple entry. Rules change; confirm on the official immigration portal before you book. Fees, extensions and overstay rules are set out in our page on how long you can stay near Da Lat . What should a rental agreement in Nam Ban include? Dates and notice. Start, end, and how much notice either side gives. Deposit. How much, and the conditions for getting it back. What the rent covers. Electricity, water, internet, cleaning, garden care — each one, written down. Repairs. Who fixes the pump, the water heater, the roof if it leaks in September. Registration. That the owner registers your temporary residence. How much does it cost to rent a house in Nam Ban? What we observed in Nam Ban in September 2026: Newly built villas: about 8–15 million VND a month (roughly US$310–580), depending on size, finish, view, garden and what is included. Ordinary rental houses: about 4–8 million VND a month (roughly US$155–310). Hotels: about 250,000–800,000 VND a night (roughly US$10–30). Homestays built and run professionally: about 800,000–1.2 million VND a night (roughly US$30–46). These are ranges, not a price list. When you compare offers, compare the full monthly cost — rent plus electricity, water and internet — and the length of stay it assumes. A one-month stay and a six-month stay are often priced differently. Is Nam Ban a good place for a long stay near Da Lat? It suits people who want space, quiet and a garden, who work remotely or are retired, and who are happy to drive to Da Lat when they need the city. It suits less well anyone who needs a hospital close by, nightlife, or everything within walking distance. A month here, before any longer commitment, tells you which of those you are. Electricity, water, internet, cleaning, garden care — each one, written down. Repairs. Who fixes the pump, the water heater, the roof if it leaks in September. Registration. That the owner registers your temporary residence. How much does it cost to rent a house in Nam Ban? It suits people who want space, quiet and a garden, who work remotely or are retired, and who are happy to drive to Da Lat when they need the city. It suits less well anyone who needs a hospital close by, nightlife, or everything within walking distance. A month here, before any longer commitment, tells you which of those you are. /en/vietnam-visa-long-stay-da-lat.desc: Staying near Da Lat for one to three months in 2026: 45 days visa-free for citizens of 24 countries, an e-visa of up to 90 days for every nationality (25 USD single, 50 USD multiple entry), temporary residence registration within 12 hours, and what a visa does not allow.
h2: Which countries can enter Vietnam without a visa, and for how long?
How long is a Vietnam e-visa, and how much does it cost?
Can you fly into Da Lat on an e-visa?
What if you want to stay longer than your visa?
Who registers your temporary residence when you rent a house?
What happens if you overstay?
Frequently asked questions
faq: How long can I stay in Vietnam without a visa?

Up to 45 days if you hold a passport from one of 24 countries: Germany, France, Italy, Spain, the United Kingdom, Russia, Japan, South Korea, Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland (Resolution 44/NQ-CP, to 14 March 2028), plus Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, the Czech Republic, Hungary, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Poland, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia and Switzerland for tourism (Resolution 229/NQ-CP, to 14 August 2028).
Can I stay 3 months near Da Lat?
Yes, with a 90-day e-visa, which every nationality can apply for on evisa.gov.vn. The fee from 1 April 2026 is 25 USD single entry or 50 USD multiple entry.
Is there a retirement visa in Vietnam?
No. Vietnam has no retirement visa and no digital-nomad visa. Long stays are usually done on a 90-day e-visa, or on other visa types that need a sponsor in Vietnam.
Can I extend my e-visa inside Vietnam?
Generally only through a sponsoring agency, organisation or individual in Vietnam. Most people apply for a new visa instead; plan it before the current one ends.
Can I enter at Da Lat (Lien Khuong) airport on an e-visa?
Yes. Liên Khương is an e-visa port of entry. It reopened on 19 August 2026, and Nam Ban is about 20 km away, 35 to 45 minutes by road.
Who registers my temporary residence if I rent a house?
The host, within 12 hours of your arrival (24 hours in remote areas). A host who does not register one to three foreign guests can be fined 3–5 million VND from 15 December 2025.

/en/cost-of-living-nam-ban-da-lat.h1: Cost of living in Nam Ban, near Da Lat: what a month really costs
/en/cost-of-living-nam-ban-da-lat.desc: Cost of living in Nam Ban, about 25 km from Da Lat, in 2026: about 200,000 VND a person a day for food, fuel and everyday spending, rent of 4–8 million VND a month for an ordinary house or 8–15 million for a villa, internet 180,000–200,000 VND — and the costs people forget.
h2: How much is rent in Nam Ban?
What do food and the market cost?
What about internet, water and electricity?
Do you need a motorbike or a car?
What about healthcare?
Which costs do people forget?
Is Nam Ban cheaper than Da Lat city?
Frequently asked questions
faq: How much does it cost to live in Nam Ban per month?

About 6 million VND a person a month for food, fuel and everyday spending (around 200,000 VND a day), plus rent of 4–8 million for an ordinary house or 8–15 million for a newly built villa. One person in an ordinary house: roughly 10–14 million VND (US$385–540).
How much is rent in Nam Ban for a month?
In September 2026 we observed ordinary houses at about 4–8 million VND a month and newly built villas at about 8–15 million. Hotel rooms run about 250,000–800,000 VND a night.
Is the internet in Nam Ban good enough for remote work?
Usually yes. Fibre is available, the three big networks cover the area, and a standard plan costs about 180,000–200,000 VND a month. Check the line at the exact house before you commit.
Do I need a motorbike to live in Nam Ban?
In practice yes, or a car. Da Lat is about 25 km away and many rental houses are on the hills away from the market.
Where is the nearest hospital to Nam Ban?
In Da Lat, about 45 minutes away, or in Đinh Văn, where the Lâm Hà Regional Medical Centre (Trung tâm Y tế khu vực Lâm Hà) is. Nam Ban itself has a commune health station and a general clinic.
Is Nam Ban cheaper than Da Lat?
Land is priced well below Da Lat. For rent and daily costs we have not measured Da Lat city, so we do not publish a comparison.
/en/cost-of-living-nam-ban-da-lat.region_text: Short answer Living the way people here live, food, fuel and everyday spending come to about 200,000 VND a person a day — roughly 6 million VND a month , about US$230. Rent comes on top: 4–8 million VND a month for an ordinary house, 8–15 million for a newly built villa (September 2026). Our rough sum for one person in an ordinary house: about 10–14 million VND a month (US$385–540), before visas and flights. A couple: about 16–20 million (US$615–770). These are our observations, not an official index; your number depends on how you live. Nam Ban is a farming commune about 25 km from Da Lat, over the Tà Nung pass. People who look at it for a long stay want one number: what does a month cost? Here is the number we can stand behind, built from what we see here, with US dollars at about 26,000 VND. How much is rent in Nam Ban? Ordinary house: about 4–8 million VND a month (US$155–310). Newly built villa: about 8–15 million VND a month (US$310–580), depending on size, finish, garden and view. Hotel room: about 250,000–800,000 VND a night (US$10–30). Professionally run homestay: about 800,000–1.2 million VND a night (US$30–46). These are ranges we observed in September 2026. A month in a house costs far less than a month of nights in a homestay. What to check before renting is in our guide to long-term rental in Nam Ban . What do food and the market cost? The Nam Ban market is open all day and busiest from about 6 to 8 in the morning. This is a vegetable- and coffee-growing area, so greens are cheap and fresh. Our figure of about 200,000 VND a person a day covers eating the way local households eat, plus fuel and small everyday spending. Eating out every meal, or cooking imported food, costs more. We don't print a price for each item because we haven't measured them item by item. What about internet, water and electricity? Internet: fibre is available and the three big networks all cover Nam Ban. A standard plan runs about 180,000–200,000 VND a month, enough for video calls. Check the line at the exact house. Water: most homes use a borehole well. Piped water has started reaching houses along the main provincial road, ĐT.725. Electricity: billed on the national tiered household tariff. Ask whether the rent includes it or the house has its own meter. Do you need a motorbike or a car? In practice, yes. Da Lat is about 25 km away, around 45 minutes over the Tà Nung pass, and Liên Khương airport about 20 km, 35 to 45 minutes. Many rental houses sit on the hills away from the market, and there is no city bus network to rely on. What about healthcare? Nam Ban has a commune health station and a general clinic. For a hospital, go up to Da Lat (about 45 minutes) or to Đinh Văn, where the Lâm Hà Regional Medical Centre (Trung tâm Y tế khu vực Lâm Hà) is. /en/linh-an-pagoda-nam-ban.title: Linh An Pagoda (Chùa Linh Ẩn) near Da Lat: Where It Is, Entry, Hours and the 71 m Statue | Namban Panorama
/en/linh-an-pagoda-nam-ban.h1: Linh An Pagoda near Da Lat: where it is, entry, opening hours and the 71 m statue
/en/linh-an-pagoda-nam-ban.desc: Linh An Pagoda (Chùa Linh Ẩn) stands next to Elephant Waterfall in Nam Ban, about 25 km from Da Lat over the Tà Nung pass. Entry is free; the 71 m Quan Am statue was completed in 2019. How to get there, hours, and the waterfall today.
h2: Where is Linh An Pagoda, and how do you get there?
Is there an entrance fee, and what are the opening hours?
How tall is the statue, and how old is the pagoda?
Can you walk down to Elephant Waterfall from the pagoda?
When is the best time to visit?
Frequently asked questions
faq: Where is Linh An Pagoda?
In Nam Ban (Nam Ban Lam Ha commune), Lâm Đồng province, right next to Elephant Waterfall — about 25 km from Da Lat over the Tà Nung pass, around 45 minutes by road. It is not inside Da Lat city.
Is there an entrance fee for Linh An Pagoda?
No. The pagoda is open freely and sells no tickets.
What are the opening hours of Linh An Pagoda?
The Da Lat tourism information portal lists visiting hours as 7:00–19:00. People come to pray from early morning; check locally if you plan to go very early or late.
How tall is the Quan Am statue at Linh An Pagoda?

71 m. Work began in 2017 and it was completed in 2019; at the time the Buddhist newspaper Giac Ngo called it the tallest Quan Am statue in Vietnam, and by early 2021 the 72 m Tay Bo Da Son statue on Ba Den Mountain, Tay Ninh, was taller.
Can you visit Elephant Waterfall from Linh An Pagoda?

The waterfall visitor site has been closed since 2021 and the main gate is locked. There is no official ticket: in July 2026 the commune ordered a household business to stop charging visitors at the falls, and as of September 2026 the province was still choosing a new investor, with no reopening date. People still walk down by unmanaged paths at their own risk; the rock is wet, mossy and steep.
Is Linh An Pagoda the same as Thien Vien Linh An?
Yes. Chùa Linh Ẩn, Linh Ẩn Tự and Thiền viện Linh Ẩn are names for the same pagoda.

Can you visit Elephant Waterfall from Linh An Pagoda? The waterfall visitor site has been closed since 2021 and the main gate is locked. There is no official ticket: in July 2026 the commune ordered a household business to stop charging visitors at the falls, and as of September 2026 the province was still choosing a new investor, with no reopening date. People still walk down by unmanaged paths at their own risk; the rock is wet, mossy and steep. Is Linh An Pagoda the same as Thien Vien Linh An? Yes. Chùa Linh Ẩn, Linh Ẩn Tự and Thiền viện Linh Ẩn are names for the same pagoda. Sources & note Location, history, statue, access and the locked gate at the waterfall: Namban Panorama's own reporting in Nam Ban. The waterfall's search for a new investor: Báo Lâm Đồng, 11 September 2026. The order to stop charging visitors at the falls: Báo Văn Hóa, 23 July 2026. Both articles are in Vietnamese. Visiting hours: Da Lat tourism information portal. Administrative name from 1 July 2025: the merger of communes in Lâm Đồng province. Names: we keep "Linh An Pagoda" in English because that is what travellers search for; in Vietnamese it is Chùa Linh Ẩn. Read next Living in Nam Ban: what is it really like? /ko/dalat-handal-salgi.desc: 달랏 한달살기를 도시 밖에서: 달랏에서 약 25km 떨어진 고원 마을 남반의 숙소 종류와 월세(신축 빌라 월 800만~1,500만 동, 일반 주택 400만~800만 동, 2026년 9월), 교통, 우기, 한국인 45일 무비자와 숙소 거주 신고.

faq: 달랏 한달살기를 남반에서 해도 되나요?
됩니다. 남반은 달랏에서 약 25km, 차로 약 45분 거리의 고원 마을로, 정원이 딸린 집이나 마을 집, 일부 빌라·홈스테이에서 한 달 이상 머물 수 있습니다. 다만 숙소 매물이 달랏보다 훨씬 적어 현지에서 직접 묻는 편이 빠를 때가 많습니다.
남반 한달살기 비용은 얼마인가요?
2026년 9월 기준 신축 빌라는 월 약 800만~1,500만 동(약 US$310~580), 일반 주택은 월 약 400만~800만 동(약 US$155~310)입니다. 호텔은 1박 약 25만~80만 동, 전문적으로 운영하는 홈스테이는 1박 약 80만~120만 동입니다. 전기·물·인터넷을 포함한 한 달 총액과 차량 비용도 함께 계산하세요.
한국인은 베트남에 무비자로 며칠 있을 수 있나요?
최대 45일입니다. 베트남 정부 결의 44/NQ-CP에 따라 한국을 포함한 12개국 국민은 입국일로부터 45일 동안 무비자로 머물 수 있으며, 2025년 3월 15일부터 2028년 3월 14일까지 적용됩니다. 더 길게는 최대 90일 전자비자가 있습니다.
베트남에서 집을 빌리면 거주 신고를 해야 하나요?
네. 외국인이 머무는 숙소의 관리자는 호텔이든 개인 주택이든 외국인이 도착한 뒤 12시간 안에(오지는 24시간) 현지 공안에 임시 거주 신고를 해야 합니다. 입주 전에 집주인에게 신고를 해 주는지 물어보세요.
남반과 달랏 시내, 한달살기에는 어디가 나은가요?
원하는 것에 따라 다릅니다. 조용함과 정원, 넓은 공간을 원하고 차로 이동해도 괜찮다면 남반, 가까운 병원과 밤문화, 걸어서 닿는 편의가 필요하다면 달랏 시내가 편합니다.
/ko/dalat-handal-salgi.region_text: 짧은 답 달랏 한달살기 를 도시 안이 아니라 조금 밖에서 하고 싶다면, 남반은 하나의 선택지입니다. 달랏에서 약 25km , 타눙 고개를 넘어 차로 약 45분 거리이고, 리엔크엉 공항은 약 20km입니다. 남반은 달랏의 한 동네가 아니라 럼동성의 별도 마을이며, 달랏보다 낮고 따뜻합니다. 2026년 9월 기준 신축 빌라 월세는 약 800만~1,500만 동 , 일반 주택은 약 400만~800만 동 입니다. 숙소 매물은 달랏보다 훨씬 적어서, 온라인 검색보다 현지에서 직접 묻는 편이 빠를 때가 많습니다. 한국 국적자는 45일 무비자 로 입국할 수 있고(2028년 3월 14일까지), 외국인이 머무는 숙소는 도착 후 12시간 안에 현지 공안에 거주 신고를 해야 합니다. "달랏 한달살기"를 검색하면 대부분 달랏 시내의 호텔, 아파트, 카페 거리를 떠올립니다. 이 글은 그 반대편, 커피 농장과 정원이 있는 고원 마을에서 한 달을 보내는 경우를 다룹니다. 조용함과 공간을 얻는 대신, 차로 이동하는 수고를 감수하는 선택입니다. 남반이 어떤 곳인지는 남반에서 산다는 것 에 따로 적어 두었습니다. 남반 한달살기 숙소는 어떤 곳이 있나요? 정원이 딸린 집(가든하우스). 커피나 과일나무 정원 안에 있는 집입니다. 느리게 오래 머무는 데 잘 맞습니다. 큰길가의 마을 집. 시장과 가게, 지방도 ĐT.725에 가깝습니다. 대신 차 소리가 있고 정원은 작습니다. 빌라와 홈스테이. 새 건물에 전망이 있는 경우가 있지만, 한 달 단위보다 1박 단위로 값을 매기는 경우가 많습니다. 해외 숙소 사이트에 올라온 남반 장기 매물은 달랏에 비해 아주 적습니다. 광고 없이 소개로 빌려주는 집도 있어서, 며칠 먼저 머물며 직접 물어보는 것이 온라인에서 일주일 찾는 것보다 나을 수 있습니다. 남반 한달살기 비용은 얼마인가요? 2026년 9월 남반에서 확인한 가격대입니다. 신축 빌라: 월 약 800만~1,500만 동(약 US$310~580). 크기, 마감, 전망, 정원, 포함 항목에 따라 다릅니다. 일반 주택: 월 약 400만~800만 동(약 US$155~310). 호텔: 1박 약 25만~80만 동(약 US$10~30). 제대로 투자해 전문적으로 운영하는 홈스테이: 1박 약 80만~120만 동(약 US$30~46). 가격표가 아니라 범위입니다. 제안을 비교할 때는 월세만 보지 말고 전기·물·인터넷을 포함한 한 달 총액 과, 그 가격이 몇 달 체류를 전제로 한 것인지를 함께 보세요. 한 달 요금과 여섯 달 요금은 꽤 다른 경우가 많습니다. 생활비를 계산할 때는 차량이나 오토바이 비용, 달랏을 오가는 비용도 함께 넣어야 합니다. 남반에서 달랏까지 교통은 어떤가요? 약 25km, 차로 약 45분입니다. 지도로 보면 교외처럼 보이지만, 실제로는 병원, 큰 마트, 저녁 외출을 위해 달랏에 "다녀오는" 거리입니다. 이곳 사람들은 대부분 오토바이나 차로 움직입니다. 개인 이동수단이 없으면 장보기 하나에도 계획이 필요합니다. 남반의 생활 편의시설은 어떤가요? 마을 중심에 하루 종일 여는 시장이 있고 아침에 가장 붐빕니다. 시장 주변에 은행과 약국 체인이 있고, 유치원부터 고등학교까지 학교가 있으며, 보건소와 종합의원이 있습니다. 병원 진료가 필요하면 달랏이나, 럼하 지역 의료센터(Trung tâm Y tế khu vực Lâm Hà)가 있는 딘반으로 갑니다. 광케이블 인터넷은 들어와 있지만, 원격 근무를 계획한다면 머물 집에서 직접 속도를 확인하세요. 남반의 우기, 비 오는 날은 어떤가요? 우기는 대략 4~5월부터 11월까지입니다. 마을 길 상당수가 붉은 흙길이라 비가 오면 미끄럽고 질어집니다. 오래 닫혀 있던 집은 우기에 습기가 찹니다. 한달살기를 우기에 한다면 집까지 마지막 길이 비 온 뒤 어떤지, 벽과 옷장, 침구에 습기가 없는지 꼭 보세요. 한국인 비자와 거주 신고는 어떻게 되나요? 한국은 베트남 정부 결의 44/NQ-CP(2025년 3월 7일)에 따른 무비자 12개국에 포함되어, 입국일로부터 최대 45일 머물 수 있습니다. 이 정책은 2025년 3월 15일부터 2028년 3월 14일까지 적용됩니다. 더 길게 머물려면 최대 90일 전자비자(e-visa)가 있습니다. 규정은 바뀔 수 있으니 출국 전에 베트남 출입국 공식 포털에서 확인하세요. 외국인이 머무는 숙소 — 호텔, 홈스테이, 개인 주택 모두 — 의 관리자는 외국인이 도착한 뒤 12시간 안에 (오지는 24시간) 현지 공안에 임시 거주 신고를 해야 합니다(외국인 출입국·체류법 제33조). 온라인으로도 할 수 있습니다. 입주 전에 집주인에게 신고를 해 주는지 먼저 물어보세요. 계약 전에 무엇을 확인해야 하나요? 물. 달랏에서 오는 상수도가 ĐT.725 도로변부터 들어오기 시작했지만, 대부분의 집은 아직 지하수 관정을 씁니다. 물이 어디서 오는지, 정수 필터가 있는지 물어보세요. 온수와 밤 기온. 밤은 서늘합니다. 에어컨보다 온수와 이불을 확인하세요. 아침 소음. 농촌이라 아침 일찍 농기계가 다니고, 수확철에는 더 바쁩니다. 계약 내용. 기간과 해지 통보, 보증금과 반환 조건, 월세에 포함되는 항목(전기·물·인터넷·청소), 고장 수리 책임, 거주 신고. 이웃. 마을에서는 전망보다 양옆 이웃이 더 중요합니다. 남반 한달살기는 누구에게 맞나요? 조용함과 정원, 넓은 공간을 원하고, 원격으로 일하거나 은퇴 후 천천히 지내며, 도시가 필요할 때 차로 달랏에 다녀오는 것이 괜찮은 사람에게 맞습니다. 가까운 병원, 밤문화, 걸어서 닿는 모든 것이 필요한 사람에게는 달랏 시내가 더 편합니다. 더 긴 결정을 하기 전에 한 달을 살아 보면, 자신이 어느 쪽인지 알게 됩니다. 특정 집이나 지역을 두고 고민 중이라면 문의하기 로 연락하셔도 됩니다. 영어 페이지이지만 한국어로 써 주셔도 괜찮습니다. 자주 묻는 질문 달랏 한달살기를 남반에서 해도 되나요? 됩니다. 남반은 달랏에서 약 25km, 차로 약 45분 거리의 고원 마을로, 정원이 딸린 집이나 마을 집, 일부 빌라·홈스테이에서 한 달 이상 머물 수 있습니다. 다만 숙소 매물이 달랏보다 훨씬 적어 현지에서 직접 묻는 편이 빠를 때가 많습니다. 남반 한달살기 비용은 얼마인가요? 2026년 9월 기준 신축 빌라는 월 약 800만~1,500만 동(약 US$310~580), 일반 주택은 월 약 400만~800만 동(약 US$155~310)입니다. 호텔은 1박 약 25만~80만 동, 전문적으로 운영하는 홈스테이는 1박 약 80만~120만 동입니다. 전기·물·인터넷을 포함한 한 달 총액과 차량 비용도 함께 계산하세요. 한국인은 베트남에 무비자로 며칠 있을 수 있나요? 최대 45일입니다. 베트남 정부 결의 44/NQ-CP에 따라 한국을 포함한 12개국 국민은 입국일로부터 45일 동안 무비자로 머물 수 있으며, 2025년 3월 15일부터 2028년 3월 14일까지 적용됩니다. 더 길게는 최대 90일 전자비자가 있습니다. 베트남에서 집을 빌리면 거주 신고를 해야 하나요? 네. 외국인이 머무는 숙소의 관리자는 호텔이든 개인 주택이든 외국인이 도착한 뒤 12시간 안에(오지는 24시간) 현지 공안에 임시 거주 신고를 해야 합니다. 입주 전에 집주인에게 신고를 해 주는지 물어보세요. 남반과 달랏 시내, 한달살기에는 어디가 나은가요? 원하는 것에 따라 다릅니다. 조용함과 정원, 넓은 공간을 원하고 차로 이동해도 괜찮다면 남반, 가까운 병원과 밤문화, 걸어서 닿는 편의가 필요하다면 달랏 시내가 편합니다. 출처와 참고 임시 거주 신고: 베트남 외국인 출입국·체류법 제33조(베트남 공안부 안내). 무비자: 베트남 정부 결의 44/NQ-CP(2025년 3월 7일). 거리, 물, 도로, 편의시설: Namban Panorama의 남반 현지 기록. 월세와 숙박 요금: 2026년 9월 Namban Panorama가 남반에서 확인한 가격대이며, 크기·마감·전망·포함 항목에 따라 다릅니다. 달러 환산은 1달러 약 26,000동 기준입니다. 법률 자문이 아니며, 출입국 규정은 바뀔 수 있으니 출국 전 공식 포털에서 확인하세요. 이곳에 대해 궁금한 점이 있으신가요? 저는 여기 삽니다. 이주나 토지를 고민 중이고, 또 하나의 안내글보다 이곳을 진짜로 아는 사람과 이야기하고 싶다면, Panorama는 기꺼이 나눕니다 — 압박도, 영업도 없이, 그저 정직한 대화로. 한국어나 베트남어 모두 괜찮습니다. 공유 다음 읽기 남반에서 산다는 것은 어떤 느낌일까?
/ko/dalat-handal-salgi.thanbai_text: 짧은 답 달랏 한달살기 를 도시 안이 아니라 조금 밖에서 하고 싶다면, 남반은 하나의 선택지입니다. 달랏에서 약 25km , 타눙 고개를 넘어 차로 약 45분 거리이고, 리엔크엉 공항은 약 20km입니다. 남반은 달랏의 한 동네가 아니라 럼동성의 별도 마을이며, 달랏보다 낮고 따뜻합니다. 2026년 9월 기준 신축 빌라 월세는 약 800만~1,500만 동 , 일반 주택은 약 400만~800만 동 입니다. 숙소 매물은 달랏보다 훨씬 적어서, 온라인 검색보다 현지에서 직접 묻는 편이 빠를 때가 많습니다. 한국 국적자는 45일 무비자 로 입국할 수 있고(2028년 3월 14일까지), 외국인이 머무는 숙소는 도착 후 12시간 안에 현지 공안에 거주 신고를 해야 합니다. "달랏 한달살기"를 검색하면 대부분 달랏 시내의 호텔, 아파트, 카페 거리를 떠올립니다. 이 글은 그 반대편, 커피 농장과 정원이 있는 고원 마을에서 한 달을 보내는 경우를 다룹니다. 조용함과 공간을 얻는 대신, 차로 이동하는 수고를 감수하는 선택입니다. 남반이 어떤 곳인지는 남반에서 산다는 것 에 따로 적어 두었습니다. 남반 한달살기 숙소는 어떤 곳이 있나요? 정원이 딸린 집(가든하우스). 커피나 과일나무 정원 안에 있는 집입니다. 느리게 오래 머무는 데 잘 맞습니다. 큰길가의 마을 집. 시장과 가게, 지방도 ĐT.725에 가깝습니다. 대신 차 소리가 있고 정원은 작습니다. 빌라와 홈스테이. 새 건물에 전망이 있는 경우가 있지만, 한 달 단위보다 1박 단위로 값을 매기는 경우가 많습니다. 해외 숙소 사이트에 올라온 남반 장기 매물은 달랏에 비해 아주 적습니다. 광고 없이 소개로 빌려주는 집도 있어서, 며칠 먼저 머물며 직접 물어보는 것이 온라인에서 일주일 찾는 것보다 나을 수 있습니다. 남반 한달살기 비용은 얼마인가요? 2026년 9월 남반에서 확인한 가격대입니다. 신축 빌라: 월 약 800만~1,500만 동(약 US$310~580). 크기, 마감, 전망, 정원, 포함 항목에 따라 다릅니다. 일반 주택: 월 약 400만~800만 동(약 US$155~310). 호텔: 1박 약 25만~80만 동(약 US$10~30). 제대로 투자해 전문적으로 운영하는 홈스테이: 1박 약 80만~120만 동(약 US$30~46). 가격표가 아니라 범위입니다. 제안을 비교할 때는 월세만 보지 말고 전기·물·인터넷을 포함한 한 달 총액 과, 그 가격이 몇 달 체류를 전제로 한 것인지를 함께 보세요. 한 달 요금과 여섯 달 요금은 꽤 다른 경우가 많습니다. 생활비를 계산할 때는 차량이나 오토바이 비용, 달랏을 오가는 비용도 함께 넣어야 합니다. 남반에서 달랏까지 교통은 어떤가요? 약 25km, 차로 약 45분입니다. 지도로 보면 교외처럼 보이지만, 실제로는 병원, 큰 마트, 저녁 외출을 위해 달랏에 "다녀오는" 거리입니다. 이곳 사람들은 대부분 오토바이나 차로 움직입니다. 개인 이동수단이 없으면 장보기 하나에도 계획이 필요합니다. 남반의 생활 편의시설은 어떤가요? 마을 중심에 하루 종일 여는 시장이 있고 아침에 가장 붐빕니다. 시장 주변에 은행과 약국 체인이 있고, 유치원부터 고등학교까지 학교가 있으며, 보건소와 종합의원이 있습니다. 병원 진료가 필요하면 달랏이나, 럼하 지역 의료센터(Trung tâm Y tế khu vực Lâm Hà)가 있는 딘반으로 갑니다. 광케이블 인터넷은 들어와 있지만, 원격 근무를 계획한다면 머물 집에서 직접 속도를 확인하세요. 남반의 우기, 비 오는 날은 어떤가요? 우기는 대략 4~5월부터 11월까지입니다. 마을 길 상당수가 붉은 흙길이라 비가 오면 미끄럽고 질어집니다. 오래 닫혀 있던 집은 우기에 습기가 찹니다. 한달살기를 우기에 한다면 집까지 마지막 길이 비 온 뒤 어떤지, 벽과 옷장, 침구에 습기가 없는지 꼭 보세요. 한국인 비자와 거주 신고는 어떻게 되나요? 한국은 베트남 정부 결의 44/NQ-CP(2025년 3월 7일)에 따른 무비자 12개국에 포함되어, 입국일로부터 최대 45일 머물 수 있습니다. 이 정책은 2025년 3월 15일부터 2028년 3월 14일까지 적용됩니다. 더 길게 머물려면 최대 90일 전자비자(e-visa)가 있습니다. 규정은 바뀔 수 있으니 출국 전에 베트남 출입국 공식 포털에서 확인하세요. 외국인이 머무는 숙소 — 호텔, 홈스테이, 개인 주택 모두 — 의 관리자는 외국인이 도착한 뒤 12시간 안에 (오지는 24시간) 현지 공안에 임시 거주 신고를 해야 합니다(외국인 출입국·체류법 제33조). 온라인으로도 할 수 있습니다. 입주 전에 집주인에게 신고를 해 주는지 먼저 물어보세요. 계약 전에 무엇을 확인해야 하나요? 물. 달랏에서 오는 상수도가 ĐT.725 도로변부터 들어오기 시작했지만, 대부분의 집은 아직 지하수 관정을 씁니다. 물이 어디서 오는지, 정수 필터가 있는지 물어보세요. 온수와 밤 기온. 밤은 서늘합니다. 에어컨보다 온수와 이불을 확인하세요. 아침 소음. 농촌이라 아침 일찍 농기계가 다니고, 수확철에는 더 바쁩니다. 계약 내용. 기간과 해지 통보, 보증금과 반환 조건, 월세에 포함되는 항목(전기·물·인터넷·청소), 고장 수리 책임, 거주 신고. 이웃. 마을에서는 전망보다 양옆 이웃이 더 중요합니다. 남반 한달살기는 누구에게 맞나요? 조용함과 정원, 넓은 공간을 원하고, 원격으로 일하거나 은퇴 후 천천히 지내며, 도시가 필요할 때 차로 달랏에 다녀오는 것이 괜찮은 사람에게 맞습니다. 가까운 병원, 밤문화, 걸어서 닿는 모든 것이 필요한 사람에게는 달랏 시내가 더 편합니다. 더 긴 결정을 하기 전에 한 달을 살아 보면, 자신이 어느 쪽인지 알게 됩니다. 특정 집이나 지역을 두고 고민 중이라면 문의하기 로 연락하셔도 됩니다. 영어 페이지이지만 한국어로 써 주셔도 괜찮습니다.

우기는 대략 4~5월부터 11월까지입니다. 마을 길 상당수가 붉은 흙길이라 비가 오면 미끄럽고 질어집니다. 오래 닫혀 있던 집은 우기에 습기가 찹니다. 한달살기를 우기에 한다면 집까지 마지막 길이 비 온 뒤 어떤지, 벽과 옷장, 침구에 습기가 없는지 꼭 보세요. 한국인 비자와 거주 신고는 어떻게 되나요? 한국은 베트남 정부 결의 44/NQ-CP(2025년 3월 7일)에 따른 무비자 12개국에 포함되어, 입국일로부터 최대 45일 머물 수 있습니다. 이 정책은 2025년 3월 15일부터 2028년 3월 14일까지 적용됩니다. 더 길게 머물려면 최대 90일 전자비자(e-visa)가 있습니다. 규정은 바뀔 수 있으니 출국 전에 베트남 출입국 공식 포털에서 확인하세요. 외국인이 머무는 숙소 — 호텔, 홈스테이, 개인 주택 모두 — 의 관리자는 외국인이 도착한 뒤 12시간 안에 (오지는 24시간) 현지 공안에 임시 거주 신고를 해야 합니다(외국인 출입국·체류법 제33조). 온라인으로도 할 수 있습니다. 입주 전에 집주인에게 신고를 해 주는지 먼저 물어보세요. 계약 전에 무엇을 확인해야 하나요? 물. 달랏에서 오는 상수도가 ĐT.725 도로변부터 들어오기 시작했지만, 대부분의 집은 아직 지하수 관정을 씁니다. 물이 어디서 오는지, 정수 필터가 있는지 물어보세요. 온수와 밤 기온. 밤은 서늘합니다. 에어컨보다 온수와 이불을 확인하세요. 아침 소음. 농촌이라 아침 일찍 농기계가 다니고, 수확철에는 더 바쁩니다. 계약 내용. 기간과 해지 통보, 보증금과 반환 조건, 월세에 포함되는 항목(전기·물·인터넷·청소), 고장 수리 책임, 거주 신고. 이웃. 마을에서는 전망보다 양옆 이웃이 더 중요합니다. 남반 한달살기는 누구에게 맞나요? 조용함과 정원, 넓은 공간을 원하고, 원격으로 일하거나 은퇴 후 천천히 지내며, 도시가 필요할 때 차로 달랏에 다녀오는 것이 괜찮은 사람에게 맞습니다. 가까운 병원, 밤문화, 걸어서 닿는 모든 것이 필요한 사람에게는 달랏 시내가 더 편합니다. 더 긴 결정을 하기 전에 한 달을 살아 보면, 자신이 어느 쪽인지 알게 됩니다. 특정 집이나 지역을 두고 고민 중이라면 문의하기 로 연락하셔도 됩니다. 영어 페이지이지만 한국어로 써 주셔도 괜찮습니다. 자주 묻는 질문 달랏 한달살기를 남반에서 해도 되나요? 됩니다. 남반은 달랏에서 약 25km, 차로 약 45분 거리의 고원 마을로, 정원이 딸린 집이나 마을 집, 일부 빌라·홈스테이에서 한 달 이상 머물 수 있습니다. 다만 숙소 매물이 달랏보다 훨씬 적어 현지에서 직접 묻는 편이 빠를 때가 많습니다. 남반 한달살기 비용은 얼마인가요? 2026년 9월 기준 신축 빌라는 월 약 800만~1,500만 동(약 US$310~580), 일반 주택은 월 약 400만~800만 동(약 US$155~310)입니다. 호텔은 1박 약 25만~80만 동, 전문적으로 운영하는 홈스테이는 1박 약 80만~120만 동입니다. 전기·물·인터넷을 포함한 한 달 총액과 차량 비용도 함께 계산하세요. 한국인은 베트남에 무비자로 며칠 있을 수 있나요? 최대 45일입니다. 베트남 정부 결의 44/NQ-CP에 따라 한국을 포함한 12개국 국민은 입국일로부터 45일 동안 무비자로 머물 수 있으며, 2025년 3월 15일부터 2028년 3월 14일까지 적용됩니다. 더 길게는 최대 90일 전자비자가 있습니다. 베트남에서 집을 빌리면 거주 신고를 해야 하나요? 네. 외국인이 머무는 숙소의 관리자는 호텔이든 개인 주택이든 외국인이 도착한 뒤 12시간 안에(오지는 24시간) 현지 공안에 임시 거주 신고를 해야 합니다. 입주 전에 집주인에게 신고를 해 주는지 물어보세요. 남반과 달랏 시내, 한달살기에는 어디가 나은가요? 원하는 것에 따라 다릅니다. 조용함과 정원, 넓은 공간을 원하고 차로 이동해도 괜찮다면 남반, 가까운 병원과 밤문화, 걸어서 닿는 편의가 필요하다면 달랏 시내가 편합니다. 출처와 참고 임시 거주 신고: 베트남 외국인 출입국·체류법 제33조(베트남 공안부 안내). 무비자: 베트남 정부 결의 44/NQ-CP(2025년 3월 7일). 거리, 물, 도로, 편의시설: Namban Panorama의 남반 현지 기록. 월세와 숙박 요금: 2026년 9월 Namban Panorama가 남반에서 확인한 가격대이며, 크기·마감·전망·포함 항목에 따라 다릅니다. 달러 환산은 1달러 약 26,000동 기준입니다. 법률 자문이 아니며, 출입국 규정은 바뀔 수 있으니 출국 전 공식 포털에서 확인하세요. 이곳에 대해 궁금한 점이 있으신가요? 저는 여기 삽니다. 이주나 토지를 고민 중이고, 또 하나의 안내글보다 이곳을 진짜로 아는 사람과 이야기하고 싶다면, Panorama는 기꺼이 나눕니다 — 압박도, 영업도 없이, 그저 정직한 대화로. 한국어나 베트남어 모두 괜찮습니다. 공유 다음 읽기 남반에서 산다는 것은 어떤 느낌일까? Namban Panorama 남반, 달랏 인근 고원 — 값을 듣기 전에 땅을 먼저 이해합니다. 문의하기

/en/foreigners-buying-land-nam-ban.title: Can Foreigners Buy Land in Vietnam? An Honest Answer from Nam Ban
/en/foreigners-buying-land-nam-ban.h1: Can a foreigner buy land in Nam Ban, Vietnam?
/en/foreigners-buying-land-nam-ban.desc: An ordinary foreign individual generally cannot acquire rural land-use rights in Nam Ban. What Vietnam grants, which routes exist, what to check before price.
h2: What Vietnam actually grants
Why Nam Ban is a different market
Where exactly is Nam Ban?
What routes actually exist?
Does a Golden Visa change this?
What to establish before you look at price
And the price?
So is Nam Ban for you?
Frequently asked questions
faq: Can foreigners buy land in Vietnam?

An ordinary foreign individual is not generally entitled to acquire Vietnamese land-use rights the way a Vietnamese citizen does. Vietnam grants land-use rights rather than private land ownership, and the 2024 Land Law sets out which categories of people may receive them.
Can a foreigner buy agricultural land in Vietnam?

Generally, no. An ordinary foreign individual cannot acquire agricultural land-use rights in Vietnam in the same way as a Vietnamese citizen. The answer can differ depending on the buyer's legal status and the structure of the transaction.
Can a foreigner buy land in Nam Ban, near Da Lat?

Do not assume so. The rural properties discussed in Nam Ban are agricultural parcels, gardens and houses attached to existing land-use rights — not the kind of qualifying commercial housing project where foreign ownership rules normally operate.
Can foreigners own a house in Vietnam?

Eligible foreign individuals can own certain housing in qualifying commercial housing projects, subject to conditions, location restrictions, quotas and ownership-duration rules. That is not the same as acquiring rural land-use rights.
Is it different if I am of Vietnamese origin living abroad?

Yes, materially. The 2024 Land Law provides specific rights for eligible people of Vietnamese origin residing abroad. Have your status confirmed rather than assuming the rules for foreigners apply to you.
Does marrying a Vietnamese citizen solve the land question?

Not automatically. Housing law provides for home ownership by a foreign individual married to a Vietnamese citizen living in Vietnam, subject to statutory conditions — but housing ownership and land-use rights are separate legal layers. Have the specific structure checked before paying a deposit.
Does a Golden Visa allow a foreigner to buy land?
No. A visa concerns your right to enter and stay. It does not create a general right to acquire land-use rights.
Where is Nam Ban?
Nam Ban Lâm Hà commune, Lâm Đồng province, in Vietnam's Central Highlands — about 25km from Da Lat over the Ta Nung pass, around 45 minutes by car. Liên Khương Airport is about 20km away.
Can a foreigner buy a coffee farm in Nam Ban?
Do not assume the agricultural land can be acquired directly. The land category, certificate, current rights holder and your own legal status all have to be checked first.
/en/foreigners-buying-land-nam-ban.region_text: Short answer An ordinary foreign individual generally cannot acquire rural land-use rights in Nam Ban in the same way as a Vietnamese citizen. The foreign-ownership rules that apply to certain housing in qualifying commercial projects are different from acquiring agricultural or rural land-use rights. Your legal route depends on your status and on the exact property. Most English-language guides about buying property in Vietnam are written about apartments in Ho Chi Minh City, Da Nang or Nha Trang. Almost none are written about a coffee garden on a hillside. That gap matters, because people arrive here having read the wrong article. What Vietnam actually grants Vietnam does not treat land the way many Western countries do. Land is held collectively and administered by the State; what people hold are land-use rights , recorded on a certificate. Vietnamese citizens can hold land-use rights under the categories and terms provided by Vietnamese land law. An ordinary foreign individual is not generally entitled to acquire land-use rights in the same way as a Vietnamese citizen . The 2024 Land Law sets out which categories of people and organisations may acquire land-use rights, and treats Vietnamese citizens, people of Vietnamese origin residing abroad, and foreign-invested economic organisations as separate categories with different rights. So there are two questions, not one — and mixing them causes most of the confusion: Can a foreigner own housing in Vietnam? Sometimes yes, under the Housing Law, in qualifying commercial projects. Can a foreign individual buy an ordinary rural land parcel in Nam Ban? Generally no. Why Nam Ban is a different market What people come to look at here is a coffee garden, an avocado orchard, an agricultural parcel with a house on it, a hillside with a view. The rural properties discussed in Nam Ban typically involve agricultural land, gardens and houses attached to existing land-use rights, rather than the commercial-housing developments commonly discussed in foreign-property guides. This is the part no brochure explains: the rules foreigners usually read about were written for a different kind of property. Where exactly is Nam Ban? Nam Ban sits in Nam Ban Lâm Hà commune, Lâm Đồng province , in Vietnam's Central Highlands — about 25km from Da Lat over the Ta Nung pass, roughly 45 minutes by car. Liên Khương Airport is about 20km away. The town sits at 800–1,000 metres , with an average annual temperature of about 19–21°C : the same highland climate as Da Lat, without Da Lat's traffic or prices. One administrative point matters more than it sounds. Since 1 July 2025 , Vietnam removed the district level. Lâm Hà district no longer exists; Nam Ban is now part of the merged Nam Ban Lâm Hà commune, and first-time land certificates are issued at commune level. If a listing still says "Lâm Hà district," it is describing a unit that no longer exists. The province's approved master plan to 2050 also places Nam Ban Lâm Hà in a specific region and urban grade — we read the document itself in Nam Ban in Lâm Đồng's 2050 master plan . What grows here is part of the legal picture too — coffee, mulberry for silkworms, avocado, vegetables. The rural properties discussed here often involve agricultural land, gardens and houses attached to existing land-use rights, which is precisely the category furthest from the foreign-ownership framework. What routes actually exist? They depend on your status, not your budget. Before the routes, one local reality: Da Lat and Nam Ban are not the same market. Da Lat is a city with licensed developments, some of which fall under the housing framework eligible foreigners can access. What is discussed in Nam Ban is rural land. Da Lat may offer a legal route; here, usually not. If you are of Vietnamese origin living abroad — your position is materially different from an ordinary foreigner. The 2024 Land Law provides specific rights for eligible people of Vietnamese origin residing abroad. Do not assume the "foreigner" rules apply to you; establish your own status first. If you are married to a Vietnamese citizen — the most common route here, and the most casually described. Housing law provides that a foreign individual married to a Vietnamese citizen living in Vietnam may own housing with the rights of a homeowner, subject to statutory conditions. But housing ownership and land-use rights are two different legal layers . Marriage is not a blanket solution, and "everyone here does it this way" is not a legal opinion. Leasing, or an investment vehicle — leasing or using a properly structured investment vehicle may be possible in specific circumstances, but neither should be treated as a shortcut to personal ownership of ordinary rural land . A qualifying house in a commercial project — a different framework entirely, and not the kind of property typically discussed here. Does a Golden Visa change this? No. A visa determines whether you may enter and stay. It does not, by itself, create a right to acquire ordinary land-use rights. Visa and property are separate legal questions. Treating one as the other is a common and expensive assumption. What to establish before you look at price Before the view, before the coffee trees, before the number: Your legal status. Foreign citizen, person of Vietnamese origin residing abroad, Vietnamese citizen residing abroad, or buying with a Vietnamese spouse — each changes the analysis, and the law treats them as distinct categories. What the property actually is. Not "a property" — residential land, agricultural land, garden, house, attached assets. These are different legal objects. Who holds the land-use rights now , and whether that particular right can legally transfer to the category of buyer you fall into. Your exit. Ask early: if I want to sell this in five years, who is legally allowed to buy it from me? More useful than "can I buy it today," and almost nobody asks it first. And the price? A cheaper parcel with a complicated legal position is not cheaper. In this area, land is priced by category and by lot — agricultural land, land with residential quota, land with a view — and the range between them is wide. Nam Ban, Bảo Lộc and Đức Trọng sit at broadly similar levels, all well below Da Lat. But for a foreign buyer that comparison is almost beside the point. A parcel you cannot legally hold is not cheap at any price. Establish eligibility first; discuss the number second. When you do get to the number, we set out what land here costs by segment. So is Nam Ban for you? If you want rural land you can simply buy in your own name as a foreign individual — honestly, no. This is not that market, and we would rather tell you now than after you have flown here. If you are of Vietnamese origin, married to a Vietnamese citizen, or your goal is to live here rather than to hold a title — the question changes, and it becomes worth asking properly. In rural property, the most expensive mistake is not paying too much. It is buying something you misunderstood. Frequently asked questions Can foreigners buy land in Vietnam? That is not the same as acquiring rural land-use rights. Is it different if I am of Vietnamese origin living abroad? Yes, materially. The 2024 Land Law provides specific rights for eligible people of Vietnamese origin residing abroad. Have your status confirmed rather than assuming the rules for foreigners apply to you. Does marrying a Vietnamese citizen solve the land question? Not automatically. Have the specific structure checked before paying a deposit. Does a Golden Visa allow a foreigner to buy land? No. A visa concerns your right to enter and stay. It does not create a general right to acquire land-use rights. Where is Nam Ban? Nam Ban Lâm Hà commune, Lâm Đồng province, in Vietnam's Central Highlands — about 25km from Da Lat over the Ta Nung pass, around 45 minutes by car. Liên Khương Airport is about 20km away. Legal basis This article is based primarily on Vietnam's 2024 Land Law and 2023 Housing Law , together with their implementing regulations. Laws and administrative procedures may change, and the applicable rules depend on the buyer's status and the specific property. Editorial note: This is a practical explanation, not legal advice. Vietnamese land and housing transactions turn on the exact land category, certificate, project status and buyer status. /en/land-prices-nam-ban.title: Land Prices in Nam Ban, near Da Lat (2026) — What It Actually Costs
/en/land-prices-nam-ban.h1: What does land in Nam Ban actually cost?
/en/land-prices-nam-ban.desc: Land prices in Nam Ban near Da Lat, October 2026: asking-price medians of about 3.43 million VND/m² for 150–300 m² plots, 2.28 for ~500 m² plots, 1.47 for land over 1,000 m² and 2.95 for view lots — and what to check first.
h2: Four kinds of land, and what each is for
Why listed prices and real prices differ
How Nam Ban compares to Da Lat
What the price table doesn't show
What to check before the number matters
Frequently asked questions
faq: How much does land cost in Nam Ban?

Asking prices, October 2026, measured to 1 November 2026 (median, number of listings): subdivided plots of 150–300 m² about 3.43 million VND/m² (40), plots of about 500 m² with residential land 2.28 million (49), land over 1,000 m² 1.47 million (38), lake, hill or panoramic-view plots 2.95 million (23, few listings). At roughly 26,000 VND to the dollar, about 132, 88, 57 and 113 USD per m². These are prices sellers ask in public listings, not agreed sale prices, measured by Namban Panorama for the Namban Index.
Is land near Da Lat cheaper in Nam Ban?
Yes. Land in Nam Ban is generally priced well below Da Lat. But price alone is a weak reason to choose a place — there will always be somewhere cheaper.
What can 500 million VND buy in Nam Ban?

In the first half of 2026, subdivided plots of 150–300 m² with some residential land and utilities in place were commonly asked at 500 million to 1.2 billion VND in total (~19,000–46,000 USD). That is the realistic entry point — suited to a small build or a weekend garden house. 500 million alone sits at the bottom of that range: at the October 2026 median, a 150 m² plot works out at about 515 million VND (median × area, for illustration).
Why do listed prices differ from actual sale prices?

A listing shows what the seller wants, not what the land trades for. In some areas the gap is significant, which is why a "cheap" number needs verifying on the ground rather than accepting from a listing.
Which type of land in Nam Ban attracts the most buyer interest?

Lots with a genuine lake, hill or valley view. They were asked at 4–6 million VND/m² in the first half of 2026, commonly 1.2–1.8 billion VND per lot; the October 2026 median was lower, about 2.95 million VND/m², from only 23 listings — too few to read as a trend.
Can a foreigner buy land in Nam Ban?
An ordinary foreign individual generally cannot acquire rural land-use rights here. Check that question before price — we set it out in full in our guide on foreign ownership.

Four kinds of land, and what each is for Subdivided plots, 150–300 m² — median about 3.43 million VND/m² (40 listings, October 2026) Small plots in an already subdivided cluster, with residential land, ready to build on. Most listings asked 2.4–5.1 million (~92–196 USD); in the first half of 2026 the common asking range was 3–4.5 million, or 500 million–1.2 billion VND (~19,000–46,000 USD) per plot. Suited to a small build or a weekend garden house. At the October median, 150 m² comes to about 515 million VND and 300 m² to about 1.03 billion (~20,000–40,000 USD). Plots of about 500 m² with residential land — median about 2.28 million VND/m² (49 listings) Frontage of 10–18 m, split off before the rules allowed small subdivision. Few on offer, and they trade well. Most listings asked 1.4–3.9 million (~55–150 USD). At the October median, a 500 m² plot comes to about 1.14 billion VND (~44,000 USD). Land over 1,000 m² — median about 1.47 million VND/m² (38 listings) Mostly agricultural land split from farms, not yet eligible for small subdivision. Suited to farming or long-term holding. Lake, hill or panoramic-view plots — median about 2.95 million VND/m² (23 listings, few) Rare, and priced by the view. Most listings asked 1.7–4.8 million (~66–183 USD). October against September. Overall, asking prices edged down: subdivided plots −6%, land over 1,000 m² −8%, plots of about 500 m² roughly flat (+2%). View plots read +27%, but September had only 15 view listings and October 23, so we do not read that as a market trend. In October 2026 supply ran ahead of demand; many sellers who needed to close quickly cut prices deeply to sell (Panorama field observation). It is not what the land trades for. In some areas the gap is significant. So a number that looks cheap needs checking on the ground, not accepting from a listing. This is true everywhere, but more so in a rural market where there is no central price index and no MLS. If you are buying from abroad, this is the single most expensive assumption to get wrong. If a place is only worth considering because it costs less than somewhere else, there will always be somewhere cheaper tomorrow. A place cannot build a future on being the discount version of its neighbour. What makes Nam Ban interesting is different, and it has little to do with the price per square metre. People leaving the city after years of running a business — not retiring, but looking for a different rhythm in which to keep working. Families who want their children growing up near trees rather than near a shopping mall; 25km from Da Lat, about 45 minutes over the Ta Nung pass, is close enough to have both. Remote workers — designers, developers, small founders — taking long-term rentals rather than short holidays. That demand exists here now, and supply has not caught up. No videos, no livestreams — some would rather nobody knew. Which means if you only watch land prices and planning maps, you miss the shift that actually matters. When cafés, homestays and shops start appearing, that is not the cause of growth. It is the consequence. Services follow people. People arrive before the amenities do. /en/nam-ban-master-plan-2050.title: Nam Ban in Lâm Đồng's 2050 Master Plan — What It Actually Says
/en/nam-ban-master-plan-2050.h1: Where does Nam Ban sit in Lâm Đồng's new master plan?
/en/nam-ban-master-plan-2050.desc: Lâm Đồng's 2050 master plan places Nam Ban Lâm Hà in the Northern Central Region and keeps the Nam Ban urban area at Grade III. What the document says — and what it does not.
h2: Which region is Nam Ban actually in?
What is this area directed to become?
What connects Nam Ban?
What the map does not say
Planning decisions on record
Infrastructure on the ground

Frequently asked questions
faq: What is Nam Ban's status in Lâm Đồng's 2050 master plan?

Decision 2786/QĐ-UBND, signed 6 June 2026, places Nam Ban Lâm Hà in the Northern Central Region of Lâm Đồng — the same region as Da Lat — and keeps Nam Ban on its list of Grade III urban areas. The Grade III status itself was set by Decision 1078/QĐ-UBND of 30 March 2026 and covers the Nam Ban urban area — the former Nam Ban town, about 20.47 km² — not the whole commune.
Is Nam Ban in the western part of Lâm Đồng province?
No. This is commonly stated incorrectly. Nam Ban Lâm Hà is in the Northern Central Region alongside Da Lat, not the former Đắk Nông western belt associated with bauxite and heavy industry.
Will the master plan make land prices in Nam Ban rise?

A plan is a foundation, not a guarantee. Across Vietnam, many places with attractive plans developed more slowly than expected. What determines value is whether infrastructure, residents and capital actually arrive.
Does the Phan Thiết – Bảo Lộc – Gia Nghĩa expressway pass through Nam Ban?
No. That corridor serves the province's southern and southwestern side. Nam Ban's regional connection runs through Liên Khương Airport and the expressway cluster around it.
Could a parcel in Nam Ban fall inside a conservation zone?

Yes, and it is worth checking before any transaction. The conservation direction that creates the area's resort value also places part of the land under development restrictions. Parcel-level zoning is still pending.
How many development zones does Nam Ban have?
The commune master plan approved on 30 June 2026 divides the area into seven development zones, with residential land at 4.02% of the commune. It is not a legal basis for individual parcels.
/en/nam-ban-master-plan-2050.region_text: Short answer On 6 June 2026, Lâm Đồng province approved its master plan to 2050 ( Decision 2786/QĐ-UBND ). It places Nam Ban Lâm Hà in the Northern Central Region — the same region as Da Lat, not the western industrial belt — and keeps Nam Ban on its list of Grade III urban areas . That grade was set earlier, by Decision 1078/QĐ-UBND of 30 March 2026, and covers the former Nam Ban town (about 20.47 km²), not the whole commune. The direction is ecological urban development, resort tourism and high-tech agriculture. But a plan is a direction, not infrastructure — and parcel-level zoning has not been published. For months, the story of Nam Ban's future lived mostly on rumour: broker pitches, screenshots of maps with no source, price predictions passed by word of mouth. Now there is an original document to read. Which region is Nam Ban actually in? This is the point most often got wrong. Nam Ban Lâm Hà is not in the province's western belt — the former Đắk Nông area associated with bauxite and heavy industry. It sits in the Northern Central Region of Lâm Đồng , alongside the Da Lat wards, Lạc Dương commune and the Đam Rông area. More precisely, it belongs to the Lâm Hà sub-region (Nam Ban Lâm Hà, Nam Hà Lâm Hà and Phú Sơn Lâm Hà) — part of the development space that takes Da Lat as its core. That distinction matters when reading the plan: the region a place is assigned to shapes which set of directions apply to it — highland resort and conservation, or industry and extraction. (Worth noting: Lâm Đồng is now a merged province — the former Lâm Đồng, Đắk Nông and Bình Thuận combined, running from the highlands down to the coast.) What is this area directed to become? The plan sets out the Northern Central Region as a centre for culture, education, science, innovation and international-standard ecological resort tourism. For the Lâm Hà sub-region specifically, the document lists: urban development · ecological and resort tourism · nature and biodiversity conservation · high-tech agriculture · clean-agriculture zones with post-harvest processing. In practical terms: Nam Ban is treated as an ecological town, not an industrial zone . Farmstays, small eco-lodging and experience farms sit on that direction. Landscape and forest are treated as assets rather than obstacles. And Appendix I of the decision lists Nam Ban as a Grade III urban area — both current status and target to 2030. The master plan did not create that grade. Decision 1078/QĐ-UBND of the Lâm Đồng People's Committee, dated 30 March 2026 and effective on signing, lists the Nam Ban urban area as Grade III. Its scope is part of Nam Ban Lâm Hà commune — the former Nam Ban town before the 2025 merger, about 20.47 km² of a commune of about 117 km². Before that, the town was Grade V (Decision 2739/QĐ-UBND, 21 December 2015). That is a designation in the documents, not a title invented by a broker. What connects Nam Ban? Another common confusion: the Phan Thiết – Bảo Lộc – Gia Nghĩa expressway is often described as "the road to Nam Ban." It is not. That corridor serves the province's southern and southwestern side. What the plan does show is regional connectivity: Liên Khương Airport — about 35–45 minutes away, positioned as the aviation gateway for the highlands. Three expressways — Dầu Giây–Liên Khương, Nha Trang–Liên Khương, Liên Khương–Buôn Ma Thuột, linking the highlands to Ho Chi Minh City, the coast and the Central Highlands. The Tháp Chàm – Da Lat railway , the historic rack line, is being restored for tourism. Nam Ban does not need a major expressway running through the town to be affected by regional connectivity. Its position relative to Liên Khương and the wider transport network matters more than any single road passing by. What the map does not say A sales pitch would stop at the optimistic part. Here is the rest. Grade III classification applies to the Nam Ban urban area — the former town — not to the whole commune, and not to your parcel. Detailed functional zoning at parcel level is still pending. A master plan is not parcel-level zoning, and neither is a land-use certificate — three different things, and confusing them is the most expensive mistake here. And there is a paradox few people mention. The same conservation direction that creates the area's resort value also means part of the land falls into protected zones with development restrictions. One line in the document creates the opportunity and draws the restricted area at the same time. A careful buyer needs to know which side of that boundary a parcel sits on. Planning decisions on record These are administrative and planning facts — documents signed, not construction: 1 July 2025. Nam Ban merged with Đông Thanh, Gia Lâm and Mê Linh to form Nam Ban Lâm Hà commune. Existing land certificates remain valid. 30 March 2026. Decision 1078/QĐ-UBND lists the Nam Ban urban area — the former Nam Ban town, about 20.47 km² — as Grade III; before that it was Grade V (Decision 2739/QĐ-UBND, 21 December 2015). 6 June 2026. Decision 2786 keeps Nam Ban on the provincial plan's list of Grade III urban areas. 30 June 2026. The commune-level master plan to 2050 divides the area into seven development zones ; residential land accounts for 4.02% of the commune. Again: still not a legal basis for individual parcels. Infrastructure on the ground Separate from the documents above — these are physical works and current status : Bridge at Tiền Lâm (locally, Tổng Đội) — construction began 14 July 2026; the contract runs to 10 November 2027, but as of 19 September 2026 it was expected to finish before June 2027 (Báo Xây dựng). Liên Khương Airport — returned to operation in August 2026. So what does this mean for a buyer? Nam Ban now has a real map, and its direction leans clearly toward ecological town, resort tourism and high-tech agriculture, in the belt around an increasingly crowded Da Lat. That is a legitimate reason for interest. It is not a reason to buy. A plan is a starting point. Parcel zoning is still ahead, and actual infrastructure progress can differ considerably from what is written on paper. Rather than asking "will this plan push prices up," the more useful question is: If prices do not move for the next two years, would you still want to own this piece of land? If you are a foreign national, there is a question that comes before all of this — whether you can legally hold the property at all. We set that out here → Can a foreigner buy land in Nam Ban? What determines value is whether infrastructure, residents and capital actually arrive. Does the Phan Thiết – Bảo Lộc – Gia Nghĩa expressway pass through Nam Ban? No. That corridor serves the province's southern and southwestern side. Nam Ban's regional connection runs through Liên Khương Airport and the expressway cluster around it. Could a parcel in Nam Ban fall inside a conservation zone? Yes, and it is worth checking before any transaction. The conservation direction that creates the area's resort value also places part of the land under development restrictions. Parcel-level zoning is still pending. How many development zones does Nam Ban have? The commune master plan approved on 30 June 2026 divides the area into seven development zones, with residential land at 4.02% of the commune. It is not a legal basis for individual parcels. Sources Decision 2786/QĐ-UBND of Lâm Đồng People's Committee (6 June 2026) on the adjusted provincial master plan for 2021–2030 with a vision to 2050; Grade III listing per Appendix I. Note: Independent reference, not legal advice or a personal investment recommendation. Before any transaction, check the original regulatory documents and the published detailed zoning. Could a parcel in Nam Ban fall inside a conservation zone? Yes, and it is worth checking before any transaction. The conservation direction that creates the area's resort value also places part of the land under development restrictions. Parcel-level zoning is still pending. How many development zones does Nam Ban have? The commune master plan approved on 30 June 2026 divides the area into seven development zones, with residential land at 4.02% of the commune. It is not a legal basis for individual parcels.
/en/nam-ban-master-plan-2050.visible_text: Namban Panorama About Nam Ban Living here Get in touch EN Home › About Nam Ban › Master plan 2050 Planning & context Nam Ban · Lam Dong 7 min read Where does Nam Ban sit in Lâm Đồng's new master plan? Updated 6/11/2026 Short answer On 6 June 2026, Lâm Đồng province approved its master plan to 2050 ( Decision 2786/QĐ-UBND ). It places Nam Ban Lâm Hà in the Northern Central Region — the same region as Da Lat, not the western industrial belt — and keeps Nam Ban on its list of Grade III urban areas . That grade was set earlier, by Decision 1078/QĐ-UBND of 30 March 2026, and covers the former Nam Ban town (about 20.47 km²), not the whole commune. The direction is ecological urban development, resort tourism and high-tech agriculture. But a plan is a direction, not infrastructure — and parcel-level zoning has not been published. For months, the story of Nam Ban's future lived mostly on rumour: broker pitches, screenshots of maps with no source, price predictions passed by word of mouth. Now there is an original document to read. Which region is Nam Ban actually in? This is the point most often got wrong. Nam Ban Lâm Hà is not in the province's western belt — the former Đắk Nông area associated with bauxite and heavy industry. It sits in the Northern Central Region of Lâm Đồng , alongside the Da Lat wards, Lạc Dương commune and the Đam Rông area. More precisely, it belongs to the Lâm Hà sub-region (Nam Ban Lâm Hà, Nam Hà Lâm Hà and Phú Sơn Lâm Hà) — part of the development space that takes Da Lat as its core. That distinction matters when reading the plan: the region a place is assigned to shapes which set of directions apply to it — highland resort and conservation, or industry and extraction. (Worth noting: Lâm Đồng is now a merged province — the former Lâm Đồng, Đắk Nông and Bình Thuận combined, running from the highlands down to the coast.) What is this area directed to become? The plan sets out the Northern Central Region as a centre for culture, education, science, innovation and international-standard ecological resort tourism. For the Lâm Hà sub-region specifically, the document lists: urban development · ecological and resort tourism · nature and biodiversity conservation · high-tech agriculture · clean-agriculture zones with post-harvest processing. In practical terms: Nam Ban is treated as an ecological town, not an industrial zone . Farmstays, small eco-lodging and experience farms sit on that direction. Landscape and forest are treated as assets rather than obstacles. And Appendix I of the decision lists Nam Ban as a Grade III urban area — both current status and target to 2030. The master plan did not create that grade. Decision 1078/QĐ-UBND of the Lâm Đồng People's Committee, dated 30 March 2026 and effective on signing, lists the Nam Ban urban area as Grade III. Its scope is part of Nam Ban Lâm Hà commune — the former Nam Ban town before the 2025 merger, about 20.47 km² of a commune of about 117 km². Before that, the town was Grade V (Decision 2739/QĐ-UBND, 21 December 2015). That is a designation in the documents, not a title invented by a broker. What connects Nam Ban? Another common confusion: the Phan Thiết – Bảo Lộc – Gia Nghĩa expressway is often described as "the road to Nam Ban." It is not. That corridor serves the province's southern and southwestern side. What the plan does show is regional connectivity: Liên Khương Airport — about 35–45 minutes away, positioned as the aviation gateway for the highlands. Three expressways — Dầu Giây–Liên Khương, Nha Trang–Liên Khương, Liên Khương–Buôn Ma Thuột, linking the highlands to Ho Chi Minh City, the coast and the Central Highlands. The Tháp Chàm – Da Lat railway , the historic rack line, is being restored for tourism. Nam Ban does not need a major expressway running through the town to be affected by regional connectivity. Its position relative to Liên Khương and the wider transport network matters more than any single road passing by. What the map does not say A sales pitch would stop at the optimistic part. Here is the rest. Grade III classification applies to the Nam Ban urban area — the former town — not to the whole commune, and not to your parcel. Detailed functional zoning at parcel level is still pending. A master plan is not parcel-level zoning, and neither is a land-use certificate — three different things, and confusing them is the most expensive mistake here. And there is a paradox few people mention. The same conservation direction that creates the area's resort value also means part of the land falls into protected zones with development restrictions. One line in the document creates the opportunity and draws the restricted area at the same time. A careful buyer needs to know which side of that boundary a parcel sits on. Planning decisions on record These are administrative and planning facts — documents signed, not construction: 1 July 2025. Nam Ban merged with Đông Thanh, Gia Lâm and Mê Linh to form Nam Ban Lâm Hà commune. Existing land certificates remain valid. 30 March 2026. Decision 1078/QĐ-UBND lists the Nam Ban urban area — the former Nam Ban town, about 20.47 km² — as Grade III; before that it was Grade V (Decision 2739/QĐ-UBND, 21 December 2015). 6 June 2026. Decision 2786 keeps Nam Ban on the provincial plan's list of Grade III urban areas. 30 June 2026. The commune-level master plan to 2050 divides the area into seven development zones ; residential land accounts for 4.02% of the commune. Again: still not a legal basis for individual parcels. Infrastructure on the ground Separate from the documents above — these are physical works and current status : Bridge at Tiền Lâm (locally, Tổng Đội) — construction began 14 July 2026; the contract runs to 10 November 2027, but as of 19 September 2026 it was expected to finish before June 2027 (Báo Xây dựng). Liên Khương Airport — returned to operation in August 2026. So what does this mean for a buyer? Nam Ban now has a real map, and its direction leans clearly toward ecological town, resort tourism and high-tech agriculture, in the belt around an increasingly crowded Da Lat. That is a legitimate reason for interest. It is not a reason to buy. A plan is a starting point. Parcel zoning is still ahead, and actual infrastructure progress can differ considerably from what is written on paper. Rather than asking "will this plan push prices up," the more useful question is: If prices do not move for the next two years, would you still want to own this piece of land? If you are a foreign national, there is a question that comes before all of this — whether you can legally hold the property at all. We set that out here → Can a foreigner buy land in Nam Ban? And if you have established eligibility, the next question is what land here actually costs → Land prices in Nam Ban Frequently asked questions What is Nam Ban's status in Lâm Đồng's 2050 master plan? Decision 2786/QĐ-UBND, signed 6 June 2026, places Nam Ban Lâm Hà in the Northern Central Region of Lâm Đồng — the same region as Da Lat — and keeps Nam Ban on its list of Grade III urban areas. The Grade III status itself was set by Decision 1078/QĐ-UBND of 30 March 2026 and covers the Nam Ban urban area — the former Nam Ban town, about 20.47 km² — not the whole commune. Is Nam Ban in the western part of Lâm Đồng province? No. This is commonly stated incorrectly. Nam Ban Lâm Hà is in the Northern Central Region alongside Da Lat, not the former Đắk Nông western belt associated with bauxite and heavy industry. Will the master plan make land prices in Nam Ban rise? A plan is a foundation, not a guarantee. Across Vietnam, many places with attractive plans developed more slowly than expected. What determines value is whether infrastructure, residents and capital actually arrive. Does the Phan Thiết – Bảo Lộc – Gia Nghĩa expressway pass through Nam Ban? No. That corridor serves the province's southern and southwestern side. Nam Ban's regional connection runs through Liên Khương Airport and the expressway cluster around it. Could a parcel in Nam Ban fall inside a conservation zone? Yes, and it is worth checking before any transaction. The conservation direction that creates the area's resort value also places part of the land under development restrictions. Parcel-level zoning is still pending. How many development zones does Nam Ban have? The commune master plan approved on 30 June 2026 divides the area into seven development zones, with residential land at 4.02% of the commune. It is not a legal basis for individual parcels. Sources Decision 2786/QĐ-UBND of Lâm Đồng People's Committee (6 June 2026) on the adjusted provincial master plan for 2021–2030 with a vision to 2050; Grade III listing per Appendix I. Decision 1078/QĐ-UBND of Lâm Đồng People's Committee (30 March 2026, effective on signing): Nam Ban urban area as Grade III, covering part of Nam Ban Lâm Hà commune (the former Nam Ban town), about 20.47 km²; earlier Grade V under Decision 2739/QĐ-UBND (21 December 2015). Tiền Lâm bridge progress: Báo Xây dựng, 19 September 2026. Administrative merger per Resolution 202/2025/QH15 and Resolution 1671/NQ-UBTVQH15. Note: Independent reference, not legal advice or a personal investment recommendation. Before any transaction, check the original regulatory documents and the published detailed zoning. /san-bay-lien-khuong-mo-lai.title: Sân bay Liên Khương mở lại 19/8/2026: Nam Ban được gì, không được gì | Namban Panorama
/san-bay-lien-khuong-mo-lai.h1: Sân bay Liên Khương mở lại 19/8/2026: Nam Ban được gì, không được gì
/san-bay-lien-khuong-mo-lai.desc: Sân bay Liên Khương khai thác trở lại từ 00h00 ngày 19/8/2026 theo văn bản của Tổng công ty Cảng hàng không Việt Nam. Điều đó nghĩa là gì với Nam Ban và cao nguyên.
h2: Một đường bay mở lại không làm Nam Ban đổi khác trong một đêm
Sân bay Liên Khương có bay thẳng Singapore chưa?
Sân bay Liên Khương còn đọc loa gọi khách không?
Bay flycam ở Nam Ban có bị hạn chế không?
Những câu hay được hỏi
Sân bay Liên Khương mở lại rồi, còn chờ gì tiếp?
faq: Sân bay Liên Khương mở lại khi nào?
Sân bay nào gần Nam Ban nhất?
Liên Khương — gần hơn mọi sân bay khác.
Từ sân bay Liên Khương đi Nam Ban bao lâu?
Nam Ban cách sân bay Liên Khương khoảng 20km, đi 35–45 phút xe.
Sân bay mở lại có làm giá đất Nam Ban tăng không?
Không tự động. Sân bay tăng lượng người ghé, không tăng giá trực tiếp. Giá tăng quanh những thứ đang được làm thật, không phải quanh một tin.
Bay từ TP.HCM đến Đà Lạt mất bao lâu?
Chuyến bay chừng 50 phút. Từ sân bay Liên Khương về Nam Ban thêm 35–45 phút xe. Nghĩa là sáng bay, trưa đã có mặt — làm xong việc, chiều về lại thành phố nếu muốn.
Sân bay mở lại thì có nên mua đất Nam Ban ngay không?

Không có lý do gì để vội. Sân bay không tự làm giá đất tăng — nó tăng tần suất người ghé, không tăng giá. Ai bảo "sân bay mở, đất sắp sốt, mua ngay đi" là đang bán cho bạn một câu chuyện, không phải một mảnh đất. Giá tăng quanh những thứ đang được làm thật. Không phải quanh một tin.
Khi nào có chuyến bay thẳng Singapore – Đà Lạt?

Scoot dự kiến khai thác đường bay Singapore – Đà Lạt từ 25/1/2027, ba chuyến khứ hồi mỗi tuần vào thứ Hai, thứ Tư và thứ Sáu. Tính tới 2/11/2026, sân bay Liên Khương đã đề xuất hãng bắt đầu sớm hơn, từ tháng 12/2026, nhưng vẫn chưa có xác nhận.
Sân bay Liên Khương còn đọc loa gọi khách không?

Không. Từ 5 giờ sáng 1/11/2026, sân bay Liên Khương đã dừng toàn bộ thông báo phát thanh thường lệ ở nhà ga; trước đó, từ 1/10/2026, sân bay tạm ngưng đọc loa mời làm thủ tục, mời ra cửa khởi hành và tìm khách. Loa chỉ còn dùng khi khẩn cấp, phòng cháy chữa cháy, an ninh và an toàn hàng không. Hành khách tự theo dõi giờ bay, cửa khởi hành trên màn hình thông tin chuyến bay.
Bay flycam ở Nam Ban có bị hạn chế không?

Có, ở một phần địa bàn xã. Ngày 14/10/2026, Bộ Chỉ huy Quân sự tỉnh Lâm Đồng cho biết 15 địa phương nằm trong khu vực cấm bay, hạn chế bay flycam, drone quanh sân bay Liên Khương, trong đó có xã Nam Ban Lâm Hà. Theo Tuổi Trẻ, phạm vi tính 10 km từ hai đầu đường cất hạ cánh và 8 km mỗi bên hành lang an toàn bay. Trước khi bay, nên xem chỗ mình định bay nằm trong hay ngoài vùng, đăng ký thiết bị và hiệp đồng bay với cơ quan quân sự địa phương.
/san-bay-lien-khuong-mo-lai.region_text: Trả lời nhanh Sân bay Liên Khương khai thác trở lại từ 00h00 ngày 19/8/2026 (văn bản Tổng công ty Cảng hàng không Việt Nam ký 12/6/2026). Nam Ban cách sân bay khoảng 20km , đi 35–45 phút . Bay từ TP.HCM hoặc Hà Nội tới Liên Khương buổi sáng, tới Nam Ban trong ngày. Điều sân bay không làm : không có cơn sốt đất nào nổ ra vào sáng 19/8 — đất không đắt hơn vì một chuyến bay hạ cánh. Cái nó thật sự thay đổi là tần suất người ghé, không phải giá . Một dòng thông báo ngắn. Nhưng đáng dừng lại lâu hơn một chút. Với người ở xa, Liên Khương có thể chỉ là một cái tên trên vé máy bay. Nhưng với vùng cao nguyên này, nó là cửa ngõ gần nhất phục vụ cả tỉnh Lâm Đồng, nhất là Đà Lạt và vùng Lâm Hà. Nam Ban nằm gần sân bay Liên Khương. Khi cửa ngõ đó đóng, mọi thứ xa thêm một chút. Khi nó mở lại, mọi thứ gần lại một chút. Văn bản của Tổng công ty Cảng hàng không Việt Nam, ký ngày 12/6/2026. Một đường bay mở lại không làm Nam Ban đổi khác trong một đêm Sẽ không có cơn sốt nào nổ ra vào sáng 19/8. Đất không tự nhiên đắt hơn vì một chuyến bay hạ cánh — ai nói với bạn điều ngược lại thì đáng để bạn lưu ý. Nhưng có nhiều thứ nho nhỏ sẽ thay đổi. Một vài khoảng cách được rút ngắn. Một vài cuộc gặp gỡ trở nên dễ hơn. Một vài chuyến đi không còn phải trì hoãn vì không có lựa chọn. Một vài quyết định được đưa ra sớm hơn, đơn giản vì đường về đã thuận tiện trở lại. Có người sẽ đến lần đầu, hạ cánh xuống Liên Khương, lên Đà Lạt bằng tuyến đèo Tà Nung và lần đầu nhìn thấy thung lũng Nam Ban mở ra. Có người sẽ quay lại sau một thời gian vì đường bay gián đoạn. Và có người chỉ vô tình đi ngang qua, rồi nhớ mãi một buổi sáng nào đó trên cao nguyên. Người vui nhất có lẽ là những người vẫn đang chờ một lý do để quay lại cao nguyên. Sân bay Liên Khương có bay thẳng Singapore chưa? Tính tới 2/11/2026 thì chưa, nhưng đã có lịch dự kiến. Scoot, hãng giá rẻ của Singapore, định mở đường bay Đà Lạt – Singapore từ ngày 25/1/2027, ba chuyến khứ hồi mỗi tuần vào thứ Hai, thứ Tư và thứ Sáu. Ngày 24/9/2026, sân bay Liên Khương đề xuất hãng đôn lên từ tháng 12/2026 cho kịp Festival Hoa Đà Lạt lần thứ XI (theo kế hoạch của tỉnh, khai mạc 19/12 và bế mạc 31/12/2026) và dịp Tết. Đề xuất này vẫn chưa có xác nhận. Hai ngày 22–23/9, đoàn Scoot đã lên khảo sát nhà ga, sân đỗ ở Liên Khương. Chuyến bay quốc tế thường lệ đầu tiên sau khi sân bay mở lại là chuyến AirAsia từ Kuala Lumpur, ngày 2/9/2026. Nhà ga cũng đã chật. Theo Dân trí ngày 4/8/2026, UBND tỉnh Lâm Đồng đề nghị Tổng công ty Cảng hàng không Việt Nam (ACV) bố trí nguồn lực xây nhà ga hành khách T2 (3 triệu khách/năm) và nhà ga hàng hóa ở Liên Khương trong năm 2027, vì nhà ga T1 (2,5 triệu khách/năm) đã chạm ngưỡng. Đây mới là đề xuất, chưa phải dự án được duyệt. Với Nam Ban thì phép tính đơn giản: sân bay cách khoảng 20km, chừng 35–45 phút qua ngã ba Cửa Rừng, đi thế nào tôi ghi ở đường đi Nam Ban từ sân bay . Khi đường bay chạy, người ở Singapore muốn lên xem Nam Ban thì bay thẳng rồi đi thêm chưa tới một giờ. Còn một đường bay thì không làm một vùng đất đổi khác trong một đêm. Sân bay Liên Khương còn đọc loa gọi khách không? Không còn. Liên Khương đi theo kiểu "sân bay im lặng": từ 1/10/2026 tạm ngưng đọc loa mời làm thủ tục, mời ra cửa khởi hành và tìm khách; từ 5 giờ sáng 1/11/2026, toàn bộ thông báo phát thanh thường lệ ở nhà ga đã dừng hẳn. Loa chỉ còn dùng khi khẩn cấp, phòng cháy chữa cháy, an ninh và an toàn hàng không. Với người đi máy bay, nghĩa là tự để mắt tới màn hình thông tin chuyến bay: giờ bay, cửa khởi hành, giờ lên tàu. Nhà ga Liên Khương nhỏ, đi vài chục bước là tới cửa, nhưng ngồi quán cà phê mải chuyện thì vẫn có thể lỡ chuyến như thường. Ai đưa ông bà, cha mẹ lớn tuổi ra sân bay thì nên dặn kỹ chỗ này. Bay flycam ở Nam Ban có bị hạn chế không? Có, ở một phần địa bàn xã. Ngày 14/10/2026, Bộ Chỉ huy Quân sự tỉnh Lâm Đồng cho biết 15 địa phương nằm trong khu vực cấm bay, hạn chế bay flycam, drone quanh sân bay Liên Khương, trong đó có xã Nam Ban Lâm Hà; xã Nam Hà Lâm Hà, một xã riêng cạnh Nam Ban, cũng có tên trong danh sách. Theo Tuổi Trẻ, phạm vi tính 10 km từ hai đầu đường cất hạ cánh và 8 km mỗi bên hành lang an toàn bay. Ngày 27/10/2026, UBND tỉnh có văn bản 18597/UBND-NC về khu vực cấm bay, hạn chế bay của Liên Khương thuộc 15 xã, phường. Tới 30/10/2026, theo Báo Lâm Đồng, bản đồ vùng cấm bay đã có trên Google Earth. Với người định bay chụp vườn, chụp lô đất ở Nam Ban, việc cần làm trước là xem chỗ mình bay nằm trong hay ngoài vùng, đăng ký thiết bị và hiệp đồng bay với cơ quan quân sự địa phương. Ảnh từ trên cao đẹp thật, nhưng không đáng để bay khi chưa biết mình đang ở vùng nào. Nguồn Văn bản của Tổng công ty Cảng hàng không Việt Nam ký ngày 12/6/2026 về việc khai thác trở lại các đường bay đi và đến Cảng hàng không Liên Khương từ 00h00 ngày 19/8/2026. Tuổi Trẻ, 24/9/2026 — sân bay Liên Khương đề xuất Scoot mở đường bay Đà Lạt – Singapore từ tháng 12/2026. Tạp chí Hàng không, 23/9/2026 — Scoot khảo sát Liên Khương, chuẩn bị mở đường bay Đà Lạt – Singapore . Dân trí, 5/9/2026 — Cảng hàng không quốc tế Liên Khương thông báo ngưng phát thanh tại nhà ga: tạm ngưng từ 1/10/2026, dừng toàn bộ phát thanh thường lệ từ 5 giờ ngày 1/11/2026. Dân trí, 4/8/2026 — tỉnh Lâm Đồng đề xuất xây nhà ga T2 và nhà ga hàng hóa ở Liên Khương trong năm 2027. Tuổi Trẻ, 14/10/2026 — cấm bay flycam, drone quanh sân bay Liên Khương; Báo Lâm Đồng, 28/10/2026 — văn bản 18597/UBND-NC ngày 27/10/2026; Báo Lâm Đồng — xây dựng bản đồ vùng cấm bay quanh hai cảng hàng không, đã có trên Google Earth tới 30/10/2026. Những câu hay được hỏi Sân bay Liên Khương mở lại khi nào? Từ 00h00 ngày 19/8/2026. Sân bay nào gần Nam Ban nhất? Liên Khương — gần hơn mọi sân bay khác. Từ sân bay Liên Khương đi Nam Ban bao lâu? Nam Ban cách sân bay Liên Khương khoảng 20km, đi 35–45 phút xe. Sân bay mở lại có làm giá đất Nam Ban tăng không? Không tự động. Sân bay tăng lượng người ghé, không tăng giá trực tiếp. Giá tăng quanh những thứ đang được làm thật, không phải quanh một tin. Bay từ TP.HCM đến Đà Lạt mất bao lâu? Chuyến bay chừng 50 phút. Từ sân bay Liên Khương về Nam Ban thêm 35–45 phút xe. Nghĩa là sáng bay, trưa đã có mặt — làm xong việc, chiều về lại thành phố nếu muốn. Sân bay mở lại thì có nên mua đất Nam Ban ngay không? Không có lý do gì để vội. Sân bay không tự làm giá đất tăng — nó tăng tần suất người ghé, không tăng giá. Ai bảo "sân bay mở, đất sắp sốt, mua ngay đi" là đang bán cho bạn một câu chuyện, không phải một mảnh đất. Giá tăng quanh những thứ đang được làm thật. Không phải quanh một tin. Khi nào có chuyến bay thẳng Singapore – Đà Lạt ? Scoot dự kiến khai thác đường bay Singapore – Đà Lạt từ 25/1/2027, ba chuyến khứ hồi mỗi tuần vào thứ Hai, thứ Tư và thứ Sáu. Tính tới 2/11/2026, sân bay Liên Khương đã đề xuất hãng bắt đầu sớm hơn, từ tháng 12/2026, nhưng vẫn chưa có xác nhận. Sân bay Liên Khương còn đọc loa gọi khách không? Không. Từ 5 giờ sáng 1/11/2026, sân bay Liên Khương đã dừng toàn bộ thông báo phát thanh thường lệ ở nhà ga; trước đó, từ 1/10/2026, sân bay tạm ngưng đọc loa mời làm thủ tục, mời ra cửa khởi hành và tìm khách. Loa chỉ còn dùng khi khẩn cấp, phòng cháy chữa cháy, an ninh và an toàn hàng không. Hành khách tự theo dõi giờ bay, cửa khởi hành trên màn hình thông tin chuyến bay. Bay flycam ở Nam Ban có bị hạn chế không? Có, ở một phần địa bàn xã. Ngày 14/10/2026, Bộ Chỉ huy Quân sự tỉnh Lâm Đồng cho biết 15 địa phương nằm trong khu vực cấm bay, hạn chế bay flycam, drone quanh sân bay Liên Khương, trong đó có xã Nam Ban Lâm Hà. Theo Tuổi Trẻ, phạm vi tính 10 km từ hai đầu đường cất hạ cánh và 8 km mỗi bên hành lang an toàn bay. Trước khi bay, nên xem chỗ mình định bay nằm trong hay ngoài vùng, đăng ký thiết bị và hiệp đồng bay với cơ quan quân sự địa phương. Sân bay Liên Khương mở lại rồi, còn chờ gì tiếp? Phần lớn người ta đọc tin này, gật đầu, ờ, rồi lướt qua. Một phần sẽ rất vui vì việc di chuyển không còn là chuyện của cả ngày đường nữa. Từ TP.HCM hay Hà Nội bay đến Liên Khương trong buổi sáng, đi 35-45 phút là tới Nam Ban, làm những việc cần làm, rồi về lại thành phố trong ngày nếu cần. Những việc trước đây cứ để dành cho một ngày nào đó, có lẽ sẽ xảy ra sớm hơn. Một sân bay mở lại không làm vùng đất này khác đi. Những ngọn đồi vẫn ở đó. Hoa cà phê vẫn nở trắng vào những ngày đầu năm. Sân đỗ Liên Khương về đêm. Chỉ là đường về đã thuận tiện trở lại.
/san-bay-lien-khuong-mo-lai.thanbai_text: Trả lời nhanh Sân bay Liên Khương khai thác trở lại từ 00h00 ngày 19/8/2026 (văn bản Tổng công ty Cảng hàng không Việt Nam ký 12/6/2026).
